🔥 The fire settles. Wei has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "The thing with headlights for eyes, standing too still — I put it down today." "Its legs lock. White light wells behind its eyes." "It drops its head — the antlers come around in a short, vicious arc." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. the woman in her 30s, with thick glasses, the lifeguard asks "Did it look at you? Before?" Vasyl breathes "The fire feels smaller now."
